6.item: ius gladii (proconsular sword-right, here Hilarianus loco proconsulis)
6.sense_relied_on: Hilarianus holding the sword-right for the dead proconsul

6.item: Fac sacrum pro salute imperatorum; Non facio / Christiana sum
6.sense_relied_on: do sacrifice for the emperors' safety — I will not — I am a Christian

6.item: ne sollicitudine infantis et dolore mammarum macerarer (purpose clause)
6.sense_relied_on: lest she waste away with fretting for the baby and pain of the breasts
